author: Bryan Archuleta
text: It could be user error, I’ve been using these sensors for the past 2 years now and have had no issues with it. The only times they have fallen off is because I hit it against something and it comes off but that is my mistake not abbots fault.

author: Dorian Stuart
text: I love my Libre 2+! I think it's a skin-type issue for most people. Some folks just have more moist/oily skin and the glue can't adhere to it. I have dry skin and once I apply the sensor, I have to pry it off when it's time to change it. I literally have to dig my fingernails under it and rock it back and forth to get it to come off.
